claim.text: The Microsoft FV documentation defines type 0 as payment at the end of the period and type 1 as payment at the beginning.
claim.subject_definition: The FV worksheet function in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop

source.excerpt: Microsoft lists type as optional, says an omitted type is assumed to be 0, and defines 0 as payment at the end of the period and 1 as payment at the beginning.
source.subject_definition: The FV worksheet function in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop
